title: Stochastically Perturbed Weights: Ensembles from Deterministic Machine-Learning Weather Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.08412v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Machine-learning weather models (MLWMs) now match or outperform operational numerical weather prediction (NWP) at global medium-range forecasting, at far lower inference cost. Many deployed MLWMs are deterministic, producing a single forecast with no estimate of its own uncertainty, whereas a growing family of trained-probabilistic models generate calibrated ensembles directly, at the price of a dedicated training run. We ask instead how much uncertainty can be extracted from a deterministic checkpoint that already exists, without retraining it. Where physical ensembles represent model uncertainty by stochastically perturbing parametrisation tendencies, we perturb the network's raw weight tensors at inference time, a scheme we call stochastically perturbed weights (SPW). We also ask whether it works, where and on which scales to inject the noise, and where it fails. A three-phase ablation across four deterministic backbones, Aurora, Grap

translated_title: 随机扰动权重：从确定性机器学习天气模型生成集合预报
translated_abstract: 机器学习天气模型（MLWMs）如今在全球中期预报方面已达到甚至超越业务化数值天气预报（NWP）的水平，且推理成本远低于后者。许多已部署的MLWM是确定性的，仅产生单一预报而无法估计自身的不确定性；而日益增多的训练型概率模型虽能直接生成经过校准的集合预报，但代价是需要专门的训练过程。我们转而探讨：在不进行重新训练的前提下，能从一个已经存在的确定性检查点中提取出多少不确定性？在物理集合预报通过随机扰动参数化倾向来表示模式不确定性的启发下，我们在推理阶段对网络的原始权重张量进行扰动，并将这一方案称为随机扰动权重（SPW）。我们还研究了该方案是否有效、应在何处以及哪些尺度上注入噪声，以及它在何处会失效。通过在Aurora、GraphCast等四个确定性骨干模型上开展的三阶段消融实验……
tldr: 提出随机扰动权重（SPW）方法，通过在推理时直接扰动确定性机器学习天气模型的原始权重张量，无需重新训练即可从现有确定性模型中提取预报不确定性并生成集合预报。
en_tdlr: Proposes Stochastically Perturbed Weights (SPW), a method that perturbs the raw weight tensors of deterministic machine-learning weather models at inference time, enabling ensemble generation and uncertainty extraction from existing deterministic checkpoints without retraining.
